items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: there’s that one, it’s on “Human Nature,” the Michael Jackson song.

ctx.x: It all works. Where I was going was that when I listen to it and, you know how YouTube is, you’re watching something and then over on the right hand side you might want to watch this. There was this video of you playing with Miles and an extended solo, and you were like really giving it all you had and you’re surrounded by electronic instruments, and the contrast between those two pieces of music was very telling. I wondered when you were playing with Miles in that kind of situation did you ever get into a…

Maybe. Yeah. Because we all had usually one solo of the night that was our main feature. I took other solos throughout the night with him but there’s that one, it’s on “Human Nature,” the Michael Jackson song. And it was just concert A minor, so B minor — are you a tenor player? I didn’t ask earlier.
